title: Cyber Defenders Intro · Welcome to the Post Office (3-5)

items.q: What does a Cyber Defender protect?
choices: messages and the people who send them
the Magpie and its shiny nest

items.q: Who is the Magpie and what does it collect?
choices: a helper owl who delivers the post at night
a new post worker who sorts the mail
a pest who collects shiny secrets
a robin who collects bright ribbons

items.q: During a check in this course, you are not sure which answer is right. What should you do?
choices: Ask a trusted adult instead of guessing
Pick the longest answer every time
Skip the check and open a game
Copy the answer from a friend
